entities.summary: Paul Kelly (b. 1955-01-13, Adelaide) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Adelaide and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
